title: Fintech Onboarding
summary: Guide new users from download through identity verification and first funded account without dropping trust or compliance.

strategies.name: Progressive KYC
strategies.tradeoffs: Faster first session vs delayed full product access; more drop-off if gate comes too late.
strategies.when: Use when browsing and education can happen before funded transfers.

strategies.name: Instant soft-verify + deferred hard KYC
strategies.tradeoffs: Higher activation; regulatory risk if hard limits are unclear.
strategies.when: Low-risk products with clear spend caps until full verification.

strategies.name: Bank-link first, KYC second
strategies.tradeoffs: Strong funding intent signal; scares privacy-sensitive users early.
strategies.when: Neobanks and investing apps where deposit is the aha moment.

strategies.name: Invite-code gated waitlist
strategies.tradeoffs: Demand control and exclusivity vs slower growth.
strategies.when: Capacity-constrained launches or regulated rollouts by region.

forgottenStates: KYC rejected with clear retry path
neverDo: Ask for SSN/NIN before explaining why
Hide fee disclosure until after deposit
Use dark patterns to force biometric consent
Show a generic error on KYC failure
Skip accessibility labels on document camera UI
evidenceNotes: Compiled from captured app journeys + curated designer wisdom.
